trigger.activation: explicit user selection of mlff/mace profile; never inferred from pair_style or elements alone

renderer_extensions.description: enforce atom_style atomic (no bond topology for MLFF); no kspace_style
emit pair_style mace and pair_coeff with user-provided model path and element order matching type_map
include forces in dump for active-learning and error-estimation workflows

static_rules.description: potential.type_elements must equal system.type_map values in numerical type order
MACE is a local MLFF; kspace_style must not appear
MACE requires atom_style atomic; bond topology is not supported
potential.artifacts[0].sha256 must be present and non-empty
fix efield must not appear; MACE does not expose per-atom charges
profile does not claim model training-domain applicability; L4 requires independent DFT validation evidence

steps: run 0: energy and force evaluation, check no NaN or Inf in thermo
short NVT 50 to 100 steps: check energy finite, no lost atoms, no atom ejection
NVE drift test 100 to 500 steps: check total energy drift within profile-defined threshold
checks: return code 0 and log contains Loop time
no ERROR, lost atoms, or NaN or Inf in log
atom count conserved between read_data and final dump
minimum interatomic distance does not collapse below 0.5 Angstrom
NVE energy drift per atom per ps within threshold

required_evidence.metric: energy RMSE and force RMSE against an independent DFT dataset not used for training
NVE total energy drift per atom per ps from a real LAMMPS run with this model
validation set covers the target composition and coordination environments

outputs: trajectory with forces (dump custom id type x y z fx fy fz)
thermo log (step temp pe ke etotal press)
handoff_targets: post-processing skill for RDF and MSD analysis
